question: Under whose supremacy did India come, after the Government of India Act, 1858?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Queen Victoria**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points**As per the Government of India Act 1858, The Queen was to become the legal owner of the Company's lands in India, and the Company was to relinquish all authority and control over those areas. The Queen was to be the head of state in India. It was Queen Victoria under who's supremacy the nation went after the Government of India Act, 1858.

 
• Government of India Act of 1858:

 
 
• East India Company's rule came to an end and the Indian Administration came under the direct control of the Crown.
 
• In England, the Court of Directors and Board of Control were abolished.
 
 
• In their place came the Secretary of State for India and the India council was established.
 
• The Secretary of State would be a member of the British cabinet.
 
• Lord Stanley was made the 1st Secretary of State for India.
 
• India Council consisting of 15 members would assist him.
 
 
 
• The Governor-General of India was also made the Viceroy of India.
 
• The 1st Viceroy of India was Lord Canning.
